claims: The merged runbook's checkpoints CP0-CP6 cover every already-audited hop from module_start to a spawned item; each cites its source audit for depth instead of restating it.

Pad provider activity is structurally proven by a fresh `activated` status plus the mod load banner: an absent/unavailable pad provider or unparsed PS5Pad.ini makes construction throw before `activated` (Native supplied input source is unavailable / PS5Pad.ini parse refusal), and RegisterKeyBind would throw 'Input registration unavailable: no active input source' so the banner could not appear.

The EngineTick F7 gate is unreachable after mods-started per worker-engine-tick-fallback; its failure signature is listed in the OPTIONS protocol as an anomaly indicator, with the pre-mods-started fatal shape ('Native game-thread initializer callback registration failed' + failed status) as the real EngineTick failure.

Rung-1/rung-2 console evidence cannot PASS this launch unless the controller stages a driver add-on writing native_query_harness JSONL to /data/modbridge-ingame-facts.jsonl (worker-rung-evidence-reader LOUD caveat); the runbook states this in the gaps section, not as a hidden assumption.
limits: No console run has ever produced any line beyond the 3 baseline UE4SS.log lines; every pass criterion here is a prediction from static traces and host tests.
Tick address 0x37ac8c0 is a prediction (linked 0x33ac8c0 + base 0x400000) with structural-only validation; no prologue byte-compare exists in the runtime.
worker-tick-callback-audit was empty; its assigned content (detour mechanism + rung-1 evidence) is reconstructed from neighbor audits and marked as such.
post_launch_check.py baseline line L2 (ACTIVATION_TEST) is reconstructed from emit-format + ledger bytes, not a verbatim console readback (tool's own honesty note).
On-screen menu visibility and the spawned actor's world presence are user-observable facts; no log can fully substitute for them (C4 video capture out of scope).
